title: Right-drag to pan the board
author: claude
summary: Right (or middle) mouse drag now moves the board; left click selects a card.
what: Panning moved from the left mouse button to the right and middle buttons. Left click selects a card; left drag on a card still moves it.
why: The user asked for right-click pan and left-click select.
how: React Flow panOnDrag={[1, 2]} in board/Board.tsx, and the browser's right-click menu is turned off on the board.
